channels.name: andy kirby
channels.why: Long-running MeshCore coverage (getting started, switching from Meshtastic, T-Deck/MeshOS, devices). Runs meshcore.co.uk and the MeshOS project (also the 'MeshOS' YouTube channel), which is separate from the meshcore.io core team after the 2026 split. Also posts non-MeshCore tech (drones, e-bikes, batteries).

channels.name: The Comms Channel
channels.why: Frequent MeshCore tutorials: 9-part QuickStart playlist, repeater flashing/config, nRF52 OTA updates, client repeat mode, release overviews (e.g. 1.16.0).

channels.name: LDSPrepper
channels.why: Very frequent MeshCore how-tos (companion flashing, backups, regions, contacts, private channels, room server/observer); 14 of last 15 uploads are MeshCore. Faith/preparedness framing aimed at church groups.

channels.name: Ham Radio DX
channels.why: Multiple MeshCore videos: app walkthrough, solar repeater build, range tips.

channels.name: IterationX
channels.why: Regular MeshCore/Meshtastic hardware reviews and builds, RF range/link-budget explainers, MeshPeaks site-planning tool.

channels.name: Mesh America
channels.why: U.S. channel posting frequent MeshCore repeater builds, weatherization and update tips (many are Shorts).

channels.name: zerofox3D
channels.why: Solar repeater and node enclosure builds/assembly guides for MeshCore & Meshtastic (creator's own 3D-printed designs).

channels.name: Ham Radio 2.0
channels.why: Large U.S. ham channel (Texas) with regular MeshCore content: app deep dive, DIY solar repeater stream, North Texas wardriving, comparison videos, coverage of the 2026 project split.

channels.name: Ham Radio Crash Course

channels.why: October 2026 'MeshCore Deep-Dive' series explaining how the protocol actually works (channels, DMs/path discovery, room servers) plus a companion buyer's guide.

channels.name: VA3BHY
channels.why: Ontario ham posting beginner-friendly repeater, solar node and regional-settings videos in late 2026. Canadian, so double-check U.S. region/frequency settings.

channels.why: Device builds and tutorials (observer on Heltec V3, T1000-E sensors, Heltec V4) alongside a lot of Meshtastic content; sells devices via LoraMeshDevices.com.
